dedupe_keys.name: chinese city and county energy consumption and efficiency

description: This Figshare deposit supplies a Chinese city- and county-level energy consumption and efficiency compilation covering 1997 through 2017. The research team publishes one Excel workbook, identified as DATASETS20220218.xls, under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The own title establishes the geographic units and period, but its short description does not list all variables, units, administrative boundaries or missing values. Those details require the workbook and accompanying documentation before numerical use. The tables can provide regional demand and efficiency context for infrastructure capacity and energy-transition simulations, and can be compared with independent proxies such as data-nasa-black-marble-night-lights. A caveat is that an administrative estimate is not a direct operational measurement from a power network or fuel-delivery system. Changes in boundaries and the meaning of the efficiency indicators also need checking before comparing locations or years. No workbook was downloaded, and the numerical estimates or coverage totals were not independently assessed.
